d: Jet black hair is styled with long, straight locks and a single thick braid trailing down the back, featuring blunt bangs and white bows. The eyes are a vivid crimson red with a youthful, wide-eyed expression, complementing a face with the apparent maturity of a teenager. The build is slender with a large bust, dressed in a blue and white military-style jacket with gold trim, a short black pleated skirt, black tights, and lace-up boots with pink ribbons. Signature details include white gloves and a long red and grey decorative ribbon that floats around the body.
